authority: routing reports requested action only; every state-changing effect is denied unless a separate trusted external owner manifest matches action, project, contour, exact scope, resources, turn and expiry
activation_gate: the tracked .codex/hooks.json is skipped until the owner reviews and trusts its exact hash in /hooks; authoritative promotion remains separate

events.UserPromptSubmit: classify intent and inject a bounded routing Context Packet; no operational authority
events.SessionStart: load project identity, exact SHA, safe recent checkpoints, and authority boundary
events.PreCompact: append a derived safe checkpoint without reading the transcript
events.PostCompact: inject a bounded resume manifest, never a transcript
events.PostToolUse: record tool name, outcome, and input/result hashes instead of raw payloads
events.Stop: append a derived safe turn checkpoint; never rewrite SESSION.md
